text.arabic_uthmani: يَهْدِى بِهِ ٱللَّهُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ رِضْوَٰنَهُۥ سُبُلَ ٱلسَّلَٰمِ وَيُخْرِجُهُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ بِإِذْنِهِۦ وَيَهْدِيهِمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ

words.gloss_range: Form IV ongoing guidance, locally active as route-leading through an inherited instrument toward people and paths
words.root_gloss_range: guiding, showing a way, leading on a route, and orienting; here the route-leading branch is foregrounded by the ayah's path vocabulary
words.prose: he term opens with an imperfect divine action, so guidance is presented as an ongoing process that follows the completed pursuit named later in the clause. The verb is not bare inspiration: 	he term makes prior revelation the instrument, 	he term names the guided recipient, and 	he term names the routed destination. The root's guide-and-route pressure fits the ayah's travel field, and the opening verb frames the later extraction and final 	he term as one guidance envelope. Same-surah contrasts such as denied guidance for wrongdoers (5:51) and the broader path formula (2:142; 2:213; 6:39) are useful as background, while the local point remains the opening mediated guidance sequence.

topics.headline: ongoing guidance by an instrument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins with continuing divine guidance mediated by the prior light/book, not with an abstract or one-time act.
topics.reason: QAC identifies an imperfect Form IV verb, and attachment evidence places {{ar:بِهِ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) as its instrumental complement before the subject.

topics.headline: recipient and route held together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guidance simultaneously selects the people and routes them into paths, making the root's path-leading force concrete.
topics.reason: The local syntax gives the verb both the person-object {{ar:مَنِ}} ({{tr:mani}}) and the path-object {{ar:سُبُلَ ٱلسَّلَامِ}} ({{tr:subula al-salāmi}}), while the root evidence supports route-leading.

topics.headline: opening guidance frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this opening guidance belongs to a wider Quranic guidance-to-path field and is locally contrasted with denied guidance patterns (5:51).
topics.reason: The inter-ayah and same-surah rows support formulaic background, but the local argument structure determines the actual sense and scope.

topics.headline: guidance encloses extraction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the central extraction is enclosed by guidance at the beginning and guidance at the end.
topics.reason: The three finite divine actions form guidance, extraction, guidance, with the same subject governing the coordinated sequence.

topics.headline: disclosure becomes guidance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clarification and light/book of 5:15 become the navigable means and path language of 5:16.
topics.reason: The opening instrument depends on the prior ayah for its referent, so the boundary rows are locally relevant without replacing the grammar of {{ar:يَهْدِي}} ({{tr:yahdī}}).

words.gloss_range: instrumental preposition plus 3ms pronoun, locally pointing back to the prior light/book complex
words.prose: he term makes the means of guidance audible before the subject is named. Its pronoun must be resolved across the boundary with 5:15, where the light and clear book have just arrived, so the ayah does not guide by an unnamed abstraction. The singular suffix can compact the prior light/book pair into one guidance instrument, while the variant vowel pressure leaves the linkage stable rather than changing the referent.

topics.headline: prior revelation as instrument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prior light/book is the means by which guidance operates in 5:16.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:بِهِ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) the instrumental complement of {{ar:يَهْدِي}} ({{tr:yahdī}}), and the referent is supplied by 5:15.

topics.headline: fronted compact means phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the compact means phrase stands between verb and subject, foregrounding the instrument before the divine agent is named.
topics.reason: The surface order is verb, instrument, subject, and the bound preposition-plus-pronoun form makes the instrument tightly attached to the verbal launch.

topics.headline: backward boundary resolution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the pronoun resolves backward to the revealed light/book of 5:15 rather than forward to the later light destination in 5:16.
topics.reason: The backward referent is required for the opening instrument; qiraat vowel variation is retained only as evidence that the pronominal linkage, not one vowel, carries the mechanism.

words.gloss_range: the nominative proper divine name as explicit subject of the coordinated action chain
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field with worship and awe-bewilderment derivational pressure; the local referent is the proper name and subject, not a debated root substitution
words.prose: he term appears after the verb and instrument even though the verb already implies a subject. That explicit nominative proper name fixes the agent of the whole chain: He guides, extracts, and guides again. The delayed order lets the means from 5:15 arrive first, but it does not give the instrument agency; the named subject unifies the three coordinated actions under one divine actor.

topics.headline: explicit subject for all actions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one named divine subject controls guidance, extraction, and renewed guidance.
topics.reason: The word is nominative and explicitly attached as subject of the first verb, while later coordinated verbs continue under the same subject.

topics.headline: agent named after means
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the staged order: action, means, then agent, without losing the agent's control over the whole sequence.
topics.reason: The surface order places {{ar:بِهِ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) before {{ar:اللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}), but nominative case and attachment evidence keep the divine name as subject.

topics.headline: divine-name resonance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the proper name belongs to a marked divine-guidance field and carries worship/awe resonance without changing its local syntactic role.
topics.reason: The semantic and collocational rows survive as resonance around the proper name, while the local parse remains the nominative divine subject.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun functioning as guided object and head of the following defining clause
words.prose: he term first identifies the human object of guidance before the path-object is named. Because it also heads the relative clause 	he term, the guided are defined by following divine approval. Later plural suffixes unfold this singular relative as a class, so the ayah moves from anyone-who-follows to the group extracted and guided onward.

topics.headline: relative pronoun defines the guided
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guidance is directed first to a grammatically defined class, not to an unnamed mass.
topics.reason: {{ar:مَنِ}} ({{tr:mani}}) is both the object of {{ar:يَهْدِي}} ({{tr:yahdī}}) and the subject-head inside the relative clause.

topics.headline: singular relative unfolds as plural group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from a singular whoever to plural pronouns that carry the whole class through extraction and final guidance.
topics.reason: The later object suffixes in {{ar:يُخْرِجُهُمْ}} ({{tr:yukhrijuhum}}) and {{ar:يَهْدِيهِمْ}} ({{tr:yahdīhim}}) return to the relative class.

words.gloss_range: completed Form VIII pursuit or following, locally deliberate tracking of divine approval
words.root_gloss_range: following, tracking, pursuing, and adhering; Form VIII foregrounds deliberate self-involving pursuit rather than passive trailing
words.prose: he term is perfect inside the relative clause, so the human pursuit of approval is treated as completed before the ongoing guidance unfolds. The verb directly governs 	he term, making divine approval the pursued object rather than a vague motive. Form VIII and the doubled sound give the following a close-tracking force, and the same root can contrast with same-surah warnings about following desires (5:48; 5:49; 5:77).

topics.headline: completed pursuit before guidance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that following approval is the completed qualifying action before the ayah's continuing divine actions.
topics.reason: The local verb is perfect inside the relative clause that defines {{ar:مَنِ}} ({{tr:mani}}).

topics.headline: approval directly pursued
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object followed is divine approval itself, packed here with a suffix rather than the full divine name as in 3:162.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:رِضْوَانَهُ}} ({{tr:riḍwānahu}}) the direct object, and the t-b-ʿ plus r-ḍ-w pairing is a marked collocation.

topics.headline: Form VIII close tracking
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form and sound present following as deliberate close tracking, not passive drift.
topics.reason: QAC marks Form VIII, and the form-specific rows identify assimilation and deliberate pursuit as local form pressure.

topics.headline: approved following versus desires
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this following is pointed toward approval, contrasting with same-surah warnings about following desires (5:48; 5:49; 5:77).
topics.reason: The row gives concrete same-surah contrast references, while the local object keeps the selected sense anchored to divine approval.

words.gloss_range: divine approval, acceptance, or satisfaction as the direct object pursued; locally approval is the clearest selected value
words.root_gloss_range: being pleased, accepting, approving, and satisfaction; the local construction narrows the range toward God's approval as evaluative target
words.prose: he term is the accusative object of following, so approval is the thing pursued. The suffix routes that approval back to 	he term, making the condition both divine possession and divine evaluation. The word functions as the gateway into the ayah's paths, extraction, and final path; its vowel variant preserves the same suffix and syntactic role, so the condition remains stable.

topics.headline: divine approval as pursued object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the condition is not vague piety but pursuing God's own approval.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as an accusative verbal noun with suffix, and attachment evidence makes it the direct object of {{ar:اتَّبَعَ}} ({{tr:ittabaʿa}}).

topics.headline: suffix binds approval to God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the suffix makes approval personal to the same divine agent who guides and extracts.
topics.reason: The 3ms suffix refers back to {{ar:اللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}), and the construction can carry both possessive and objective pressure without changing the local object role.

topics.headline: approval gates the sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the later guidance, extraction, and path language unfolds for the class defined by pursuing approval.
topics.reason: The relative clause defines the guided object, and same-surah r-ḍ-w rows connect the approval vocabulary to the local condition.

topics.headline: variant keeps the condition stable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the variant vowel changes recitation texture while preserving approval, suffix, and syntax.
topics.reason: The qiraat row is retained as recitational evidence, but it does not create a different local sense.

words.gloss_range: plural ways or paths, locally construct-bound to peace/soundness and functioning as the routed object of guidance
words.root_gloss_range: road, way, path, means, cause, and access; local plural construct foregrounds multiple guided routes or means
words.prose: he term names the path-object of the opening guidance. As a construct head it gains specificity from 	he term, so these are not generic plural ways but defined ways of peace and soundness. The plural is load-bearing: it turns guidance into traversable access through multiple routes before the ayah converges on the singular 	he term. The contrast with warnings against plural ways (6:153) survives only because the local qualifier makes this plural positive.

topics.headline: construct path-object of guidance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guidance routes the followers into specific peace-defined ways, not merely toward an abstract good.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:سُبُلَ ٱلسَّلَامِ}} ({{tr:subula al-salāmi}}) the path-object of {{ar:يَهْدِي}} ({{tr:yahdī}}), with {{ar:ٱلسَّلَامِ}} ({{tr:al-salāmi}}) completing the construct.

topics.headline: path also carries means
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word can carry both road and means pressure, matching the ayah's instrument-and-route logic.
topics.reason: The broader s-b-l range includes path and means, and the local clause already foregrounds instrumentality through {{ar:بِهِ}} ({{tr:bihi}}).

topics.headline: plural ways converge to one path
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's movement from plural peace-pathways to a singular straight path.
topics.reason: {{ar:سُبُلَ}} ({{tr:subula}}) is plural and construct, while the closing route is singular and indefinite.

topics.headline: positive plural ways by qualifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that plural ways are not automatically dispersive here; the peace qualifier makes the common path-root's plurality constructive.
topics.reason: The contrast with 6:153 is retained as a qualified contrast, because local idafa with {{ar:ٱلسَّلَامِ}} ({{tr:al-salāmi}}) determines the positive value.

topics.headline: plural stable under compression
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recitational compression can change the word's weight while leaving its plural construct role intact.
topics.reason: The qiraat row affects recited shape, not the local plural construct function.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive peace, safety, soundness, or wholeness defining the plural paths; divine-name pressure is retained as resonance
words.root_gloss_range: peace, safety, wholeness, freedom from defect, submission-related soundness, and the divine name al-Salām; local idafa selects the qualifying domain of the paths
words.prose: he term completes the construct and defines what kind of paths are being given. Its genitive case keeps it from becoming another object of guidance; it is the qualifier that turns plural ways into ways of safety, soundness, and peace. The definite form also leaves divine-name pressure available, especially in light of 	he term as a name in 59:23, but the local grammar does not force the phrase to mean only a divine-name genitive. Its root range lets the plural routes cohere as whole and non-dispersive before the ayah moves to the singular path.

topics.headline: peace defines the paths
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that peace and soundness are the defining domain of the plural paths, not a separate destination.
topics.reason: {{ar:السَّلَامِ}} ({{tr:al-salāmi}}) is genitive in idafa with {{ar:سُبُلَ}} ({{tr:subula}}), so it qualifies the path phrase.

topics.headline: peace as sound wholeness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the paths are marked by intact soundness and safety, not merely by the absence of conflict.
topics.reason: The supplied root range includes safety, soundness, peace, and submission-related wholeness; the local maṣdar form keeps those related values available.

topics.headline: divine-name resonance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a possible resonance with {{ar:ٱلسَّلَام}} ({{tr:al-Salām}}) as a divine name (59:23), while the phrase still locally qualifies the paths.
topics.reason: The definite form permits divine-name pressure, but the attachment guardrail keeps the word as genitive qualifier of {{ar:سُبُلَ}} ({{tr:subula}}).

topics.headline: peace routes, not only peace abode
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that peace appears here as route language, in contrast with abode language in 10:25 and with local submission vocabulary in the surah.
topics.reason: The cross-reference and same-surah rows are useful resonance, but the local construct makes {{ar:السَّلَامِ}} ({{tr:al-salāmi}}) the path qualifier.

topics.headline: peace makes plurality coherent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the qualifier is what keeps the plural paths from reading as dispersive.
topics.reason: The qualifier supplies safety and soundness to the plural paths, and even the assimilated article fuses definiteness into the root sound.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction introducing the second divine action
words.prose: he term does more than continue sound; it joins a new finite verb after the first guidance clause has reached 	he term. The particle therefore makes extraction a second coordinated divine act, not a modifier of the prior destination. Its repetition with the later 	he term helps the ayah sound like three action beats.

topics.headline: second divine action introduced
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that extraction is added as its own coordinated action after the first guidance beat.
topics.reason: The conjunction precedes a new finite verb coordinated with the opening guidance clause.

topics.headline: audible beat transition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the repeated conjunctions mark the transition into the second and third divine actions.
topics.reason: Both conjunctions introduce coordinated finite verbs, creating a three-beat progression.

words.gloss_range: Form IV causative extraction with plural object suffix, locally the central darkness-to-light transfer
words.root_gloss_range: going out, emerging, exiting, and causing to go out; Form IV here makes God the cause of the group's boundary-crossing
words.prose: he term is the middle action of the ayah's guidance envelope. Form IV makes the extraction causative: the group does not simply exit; God brings them out. The suffix carries the earlier 	he term into plural affectedness, and the verb's full frame gives object, source, goal, and authorization: from 	he term, to 	he term, by 	he term. The familiar darkness-to-light formula (2:257; 14:1) is active, but here it is conditioned by following divine approval and placed between two guidance clauses.

topics.headline: causative extraction at the center
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah's middle movement is a divine caused exit, not self-initiated progress.
topics.reason: QAC marks Form IV imperfect, and the root/form evidence supports causative bringing-out as the local action.

topics.headline: object source goal authorization
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the complete transfer frame: the same group is brought from darknesses into light under divine authorization.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence supplies the object suffix, source phrase, goal phrase, and means phrase governed by the extraction verb.

topics.headline: formula locally conditioned
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the known darkness-to-light extraction formula (2:257; 14:1), now tied to those who followed approval.
topics.reason: The formulaic parallel survives, but the local relative clause supplies the entry condition for the group in 5:16.

topics.headline: paired imperfect divine action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that extraction sounds and functions as the forceful middle action within the same continuing divine-action cadence.
topics.reason: The waw-prefixed imperfect coordinates with the later waw-prefixed guidance verb, while its rougher sound texture is local to the extraction surface.

topics.headline: hiddenness answered by extraction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prior ayah's concealment is answered by being brought out of darkness in 5:16.
topics.reason: The boundary row links 5:15 concealment with 5:16's extraction from darkness without requiring the earlier root to repeat.

words.gloss_range: source preposition marking the origin left behind in the extraction vector
words.prose: he term gives the extraction its point of departure. It governs 	he term, making darknesses the source left behind, while the paired 	he term supplies the endpoint. The particle also carries the boundary's source logic into exit logic: the verse moves from what came from God in 5:15 to what people are brought out from in 5:16.

topics.headline: source left behind
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that darkness is explicitly the origin being left, not a general atmosphere.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) govern the darkness noun as source and pairs it with the following goal preposition.

topics.headline: source logic becomes exit logic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary shift from revelation source relations in 5:15 to an extraction source in 5:16.
topics.reason: The boundary row is relevant because the same prepositional logic helps connect the prior revelation scene with the current extraction movement.

words.gloss_range: definite plural darknesses as the source of extraction, carrying both obscurity and moral misplacement pressure
words.root_gloss_range: darkness, obscurity, wrong, injustice, and putting out of place; local plural source keeps visual and moral dimensions together
words.prose: he term is the genitive source from which the guided are brought out. Its definite plural form contrasts with singular definite 	he term: the starting pole is layered and multiple, while the endpoint is unified. The root keeps visual darkness and moral misplacement together, so the extraction is not merely informational improvement. The broader formula can run in the opposite direction in 2:257, but 5:16 selects the positive movement from darknesses into light.

topics.headline: darknesses as source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the darknesses are the origin of a defined transfer within a larger navigation field.
topics.reason: {{ar:الظُّلُمَاتِ}} ({{tr:al-ẓulumāti}}) is genitive after {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}), and the phrase forms the source pole of the extraction vector.

topics.headline: multiple darknesses, unified light
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the morphological asymmetry: plural darknesses are answered by singular light.
topics.reason: The local forms are definite plural for darkness and definite singular for light, making number contrast part of the transfer.

topics.headline: obscurity with moral misplacement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the darkness left behind carries both perceptual obscurity and wrongdoing or misplacement pressure.
topics.reason: The v4 semantics and same-surah ẓ-l-m field support both darkness and wrong, while the light contrast prevents reducing the word to only moral wrongdoing.

topics.headline: positive formula direction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the known darkness-light formula includes possible reversal (2:257), but this ayah chooses divine extraction toward light.
topics.reason: Formulaic and same-surah contrasts are relevant background, but local prepositions fix the movement from darknesses to light.

topics.headline: dark pole made heavy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the darkness pole remains stable under recitation and answers the prior ayah's concealment with a heavy negative source.
topics.reason: The qiraat row preserves plural definiteness, the phonetic row belongs to the local surface, and the boundary row ties darkness to prior hiddenness.

words.gloss_range: directional preposition marking the light as endpoint of extraction
words.prose: he term completes the central transfer by making 	he term the endpoint. Paired with 	he term, it gives 	he term a full source-to-goal axis. Its later repetition before 	he term links light and path as successive destinations in the ayah's route.

topics.headline: light as destination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that light is the goal of movement, not just an image beside the verb.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}) govern the light noun as the goal of extraction.

topics.headline: repeated destination marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the repeated long destination marker links the move into light with the move onto the final path.
topics.reason: The same preposition occurs before both destination nouns in the ayah.

words.gloss_range: definite singular light as the endpoint of extraction, locally both revealed light from 5:15 and perceptual illumination
words.root_gloss_range: light, illumination, visibility, and perception; local endpoint function selects light as the clarified destination of extraction
words.prose: he term is the genitive endpoint after 	he term. Its article resumes the prior ayah's indefinite 	he term as an established destination: what arrived in 5:15 becomes where the guided are brought in 5:16. The singular definite light answers the plural darknesses with a unified perceptual endpoint, so the movement is from layered obscurity into identifiable illumination.

topics.headline: light endpoint of extraction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that light is grammatically the endpoint of extraction.
topics.reason: {{ar:النُّورِ}} ({{tr:al-nūri}}) is genitive after the directional preposition and belongs to the darkness-to-light formula.

topics.headline: arriving light becomes goal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the light announced in 5:15 becomes the definite destination in 5:16.
topics.reason: Boundary evidence links the indefinite prior {{ar:نُور}} ({{tr:nūr}}) with the definite endpoint {{ar:النُّورِ}} ({{tr:al-nūri}}).

topics.headline: unified perceptual light
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the endpoint is singular perceiving light, set against dense plural darknesses.
topics.reason: The n-w-r semantics support perception and illumination, and the local number contrast makes the light pole unified.

topics.headline: gift turns into extraction goal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the role shift across the boundary: light arrives as gift, then functions as extraction goal.
topics.reason: The boundary rows specifically track the change from announced light in 5:15 to definite destination in 5:16.

words.gloss_range: instrumental or causal bāʾ introducing the divine authorization phrase
words.prose: he term introduces the authorization phrase 	he term. It makes permission an enabling means or condition for the extraction and, by placement, lets that authorization color the transition into final guidance. Because the preposition is proclitic, the phrase is heard as one inseparable unit of authorization.

topics.headline: bāʾ introduces authorization
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the permission phrase is grammatically introduced as the enabling condition of the movement.
topics.reason: The preposition governs {{ar:إِذْنِهِ}} ({{tr:idhnihi}}) and attaches the authorization phrase to the extraction clause.

topics.headline: permission fused into one unit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the proclitic makes the authorization phrase sound inseparable from its governed noun.
topics.reason: The bāʾ is bound directly to the following verbal noun, matching its grammatical role as a compact means phrase.

words.gloss_range: permission or authorization as a genitive verbal noun with divine suffix, locally the enabling condition for extraction and transition
words.root_gloss_range: hearing, giving ear, allowing, permitting, and authorizing; local means phrase selects authorization with attentive-heeding resonance
words.prose: he term supplies the governed noun of 	he term, so authorization is the means or enabling condition under which extraction occurs. The suffix returns permission to 	he term, preventing it from becoming an abstract license detached from the guiding agent. Its placement after darkness-to-light movement and before renewed guidance lets it work locally on extraction while also coloring the whole chain. The root's hearing-and-permitting range makes the authorization feel attentive rather than administrative, and the parallels with guidance by permission (2:213), bringing out by permission (14:1), and same-surah authorized acts (5:110) reinforce that formal enabling force.

topics.headline: local extraction, wider chain color
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that permission locally authorizes extraction while its hinge position can color the transition to final guidance.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence strongly licenses the phrase with extraction, while broader-scope pressure survives because of its position before the closing guidance clause.

topics.headline: permission belongs to God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that authorization is a standing genitive condition possessed by the same divine agent.
topics.reason: The word is genitive after {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}), is a verbal noun, and carries the 3ms suffix referring to {{ar:اللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}).

topics.headline: authorization with hearing pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that permission is framed as attentive authorization rooted in hearing and giving ear, not casual allowance.
topics.reason: The root range includes hearing and permission; the local divine means phrase selects authorization while preserving attentive-heeding pressure.

topics.headline: permission fuses formulas
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 5:16 combines guidance-by-permission and bringing-out-by-permission patterns (2:213; 14:1), with same-surah authorization resonance (5:110).
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete references, and the local phrase stands inside both extraction and guidance frames.

topics.headline: audible authorization catch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the small sound break at the authorization phrase, matching its hinge function.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is local to the phrase and coheres with its placement between extraction and final guidance.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction introducing the third divine action after the permission phrase
words.prose: he term introduces the third finite divine action after the authorization phrase. The conjunction prevents the closing guidance from collapsing into a restatement of extraction; it adds a new routed act after the group has been brought into light. Together with the earlier 	he term, it divides the ayah into guidance, extraction, and final guidance.

topics.headline: third divine action introduced
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that final path-guidance is a new coordinated act after extraction.
topics.reason: The conjunction joins a new finite verb after {{ar:بِإِذْنِهِ}} ({{tr:bi-idhnihi}}), making the closing clause coordinated.

topics.headline: three beats divided by conjunctions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the two conjunctions audibly divide the three divine actions.
topics.reason: Both conjunctions introduce coordinated clauses under the same divine subject.

words.gloss_range: repeated Form IV guidance with plural object suffix and directional path complement
words.root_gloss_range: guiding, route-leading, directing, and showing a way; local reprise lands that guidance on the extracted group and final path
words.prose: he term resumes the opening guidance root but now with the plural object suffix explicit. The group defined by 	he term and carried through 	he term is now guided toward 	he term. The verb therefore narrows the opening guidance: after plural paths and extraction into light, guidance lands on a single final route. The h-d-y, kh-r-j, h-d-y pattern makes the extraction the middle transformation inside a guidance frame.

topics.headline: guidance of the extracted group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing guidance is directed to the same group already defined and extracted.
topics.reason: The attached plural suffix is the direct object and echoes the object suffix of {{ar:يُخْرِجُهُمْ}} ({{tr:yukhrijuhum}}).

topics.headline: recipient and path destination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb governs both the people guided and the route toward which they are guided.
topics.reason: The verb takes a direct object suffix and an {{ar:إِلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ilā}}) destination phrase ending in {{ar:صِرَاطٍ}} ({{tr:ṣirāṭin}}).

topics.headline: guidance returns at closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends by returning to its opening guidance root and landing that return on path language.
topics.reason: The h-d-y plus ṣ-r-ṭ pairing closes the ayah after the earlier plural path and extraction language.

topics.headline: opening guidance narrowed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the progression from whoever is guided to the extracted group guided toward one path.
topics.reason: The opening h-d-y clause and closing h-d-y clause frame the extraction, with the second verb adding the plural object suffix and path destination.

words.gloss_range: directional preposition marking the final path as destination
words.prose: he term makes the final path the destination of renewed guidance. It prevents the closing phrase from being only information about a path; the group is guided toward it. Because the earlier 	he term pointed to light, this repetition makes light and path successive endpoints in the ayah's movement.

topics.headline: final path as destination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final clause guides the group toward a path, not merely about a path.
topics.reason: The preposition governs {{ar:صِرَاطٍ}} ({{tr:ṣirāṭin}}) as the destination complement of {{ar:يَهْدِيهِمْ}} ({{tr:yahdīhim}}).

topics.headline: light and path endpoints linked
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that repeated destination marking links the light endpoint with the final path endpoint.
topics.reason: Both destination prepositions govern major endpoint nouns in the ayah's route sequence.

words.gloss_range: indefinite singular path as the final destination of guidance, carrying broad route and recitational emphatic pressure
words.root_gloss_range: clear road, wide route, path, crossing, and swallowing-road imagery; local grammar selects the final traversable route
words.prose: he term is the genitive destination after the final 	he term. Unlike the earlier plural 	he term, it is singular and indefinite, so the ayah's movement converges from peace-pathways into a granted final route. Its indefiniteness contrasts with the familiar definite formula in 1:6, making the path here a route reached within this ayah's process. The root image gives the path breadth and traversability, and the ṣād/sīn qiraat evidence changes recited texture without changing the referent.

topics.headline: path governed as goal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing path is the goal of renewed guidance and the landing of the ayah's movement.
topics.reason: {{ar:صِرَاطٍ}} ({{tr:ṣirāṭin}}) is genitive after {{ar:إِلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ilā}}), so it is governed as the destination of {{ar:يَهْدِيهِمْ}} ({{tr:yahdīhim}}).

topics.headline: one granted path after many ways
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that plural ways converge into an indefinite singular path, unlike the definite straight-path wording of 1:6.
topics.reason: The local form is singular indefinite and follows earlier plural {{ar:سُبُلَ}} ({{tr:subula}}), while the reference to 1:6 is a contrast in definiteness.

topics.headline: broad traversable route
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final path is a full traversable route that receives the extracted group, not a narrow hint.
topics.reason: The supplied ṣ-r-ṭ evidence supports road, wide route, bridge, and engulfing path imagery, which fits the post-extraction destination.

topics.headline: fixed straight-path field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that {{ar:صِرَاطٍ}} ({{tr:ṣirāṭin}}) and {{ar:مُسْتَقِيمٍ}} ({{tr:mustaqīmin}}) activate a concentrated Quranic straight-path pair while remaining indefinite here.
topics.reason: The adjacent ṣ-r-ṭ and q-w-m forms produce the final straight-path phrase, with a contrast to the definite wording in 1:6.

topics.headline: recited path texture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that canonical recitation varies the path's sound texture while the path meaning remains stable.
topics.reason: The qiraat and phonetic rows affect ṣād/sīn/emphatic texture, but they do not alter the local destination role.

words.gloss_range: indefinite genitive Form X active participle qualifying the final path as straight, upright, and maintained
words.root_gloss_range: standing, rising, establishing, maintaining, and uprightness; local Form X participle selects stable maintained straightness
words.prose: he term agrees with 	he term in genitive case and indefiniteness, so straightness is locked to the final path. The q-w-m root makes this more than a line: the path stands, holds upright, and resists collapse or deviation. As a Form X active participle, the word presents uprightness as a durable maintained quality. The paired tanwīn and the strong ṣ-r-ṭ plus q-w-m field make the final two words the stabilized landing of the ayah's route movement.

topics.headline: adjective locked to path
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that straightness belongs specifically to the final path, because case and indefiniteness agree.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify {{ar:مُسْتَقِيمٍ}} ({{tr:mustaqīmin}}) as the adjective of {{ar:صِرَاطٍ}} ({{tr:ṣirāṭin}}), matching it in genitive indefiniteness.

topics.headline: straightness as standing stability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that straightness is grounded in upright standing and maintained stability, not only geometric direction.
topics.reason: The q-w-m root range includes standing, rising, establishing, and maintaining, which supports the stable-upright sense in this adjective.

topics.headline: maintained upright quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form presents straightness as a durable maintained property of the path.
topics.reason: QAC marks a Form X active participle, and the form rows support maintained or stabilized uprightness.

topics.headline: stabilized final landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final phrase resolves the ayah's whole route language into a stabilized straight-path formula.
topics.reason: The q-w-m and ṣ-r-ṭ pair is strongly concentrated in straight-path language, and the final adjective supplies the qualitative resolution.

topics.headline: paired tanwīn closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the matching -in endings bind the route and its quality at the close.
topics.reason: The noun and adjective share genitive indefinite endings, producing both grammatical concord and audible closure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated guidance verbs frame the person who follows God's approval.
baseline_models.mechanism: Divine leading supplies a direction, while following supplies sustained tracking and approval supplies the criterion. Guidance therefore works as a response-conditioned movement rather than as information deposited in a passive recipient.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward a road supplies the divine lead that frames the sequence.
Following behind makes the recipient an active tracker of that lead.
Abundant or sought approval names the orientation being tracked.
Acceptance rather than displeasure gives the orientation its evaluative polarity.

changed_reading.before: God gives a person directions toward a good destination.
changed_reading.after: God's gentle lead becomes an itinerary through the person's continued tracking of what God accepts.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Plural paths of peace precede a singular straight path.
baseline_models.mechanism: Several traversable routes can carry intactness and reconciliation, yet they converge on one balanced course that holds life and action upright. The plurality is functional variety, not incoherence.

activation_trace.role: An extended traversable road gives each plural path concrete continuity.
Freedom from damage makes safety an achieved condition of the routes.
Reconciliation opposite warfare gives the routes a social function.
The singular road supplies the convergent course.
Balance and straightness define the course's alignment.
A sustaining support makes straightness something that keeps a life standing.

changed_reading.before: Peace is reached by one correct road.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: God brings them from plural darknesses into singular light by His permission.
baseline_models.mechanism: The transfer is both relocation and disclosure: layered misplacements and obstructions are left for a visible, navigable condition. Permission marks the transition as a deliberate authorization rather than an automatic optical event.

activation_trace.role: Passage to the outside supplies the spatial transfer.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the disclosure dimension.
Material misplacement makes one darkness a state in which things no longer occupy their due positions.
Withholding and confinement add obstruction to the darknesses.
Illumination gives the destination ordinary visibility.
A conspicuous road mark makes the light navigable rather than merely bright.
Authorization governs the transfer.

changed_reading.after: God authorizes a transfer out of layered obstruction and dislocation into disclosed, navigable order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same guidance root appears as a marked offering physically led toward sanctuary among people deliberately aiming at the Sacred House and seeking approval. This materializes guidance as protected, purposive convoy movement, not only cognitive direction.

activation_trace.role: Gentle road-leading anchors the changed model in the focus verbs.
A consecrated offering led to sanctuary gives guidance an embodied transport image.
A neck marker makes the convoy's protected purpose publicly legible.
Deliberate aiming supplies the travelers' directed agency.
A dwelling or refuge gives the movement a receiving center.
Protected spatial boundaries surround the destination and its approach.
Sought approval explicitly matches the focus movement's criterion.

structural_cues: 5:2 places the offering, its collars, sanctuary-bound travelers, the Sacred House, and sought approval inside one movement sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a ritual convoy and exact guidance/approval root echoes; I let that convoy color the focus as embodied protected movement. A live alternative keeps the sacrificial noun and the guidance verbs semantically separate.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is an inward grasp of directions.
changed_reading.after: Guidance can be experienced as a marked, protected approach in which a follower is steadily conducted toward sacred refuge and approval.

context_deltas.mechanism: Water washing and clean-earth wiping are condition-sensitive routes to the same purified state. Their substitution, coupled with the stated rejection of constriction, makes the plural paths routes adapted to circumstance while still converging on one completed alignment.

activation_trace.role: Plural traversable routes anchor the availability of more than one valid procedure.
Leaving one state for another anchors purification as an enacted transition.
Flowing water removes adhering dirt and supplies the default material route.
Passing the hand and removing a trace supplies a lighter embodied operation.
Removal of impurity names the shared end state.
Water identifies the ordinary medium whose absence activates an alternative.
The clean-earth procedure supplies the alternate route under constrained conditions.
The face of the earth supplies the substitute material.
The denial of constriction prevents one route from becoming an impassable bottleneck.
Completion makes the alternate routes converge on a fulfilled purpose.

structural_cues: 5:6 alternates water and clean earth according to illness, travel, and availability, then states that the purpose is purification and completion rather than hardship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two embodied procedures, conditional substitution, and one stated purpose; I map that topology onto plural paths converging on one straight course. The alternative is that the purification rule merely exemplifies flexibility without defining the focus metaphor.

changed_reading.before: The plural paths are several abstract teachings.
changed_reading.after: They can be circumstance-sensitive procedures that move different bodies through different media toward the same purified and completed orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The route is repeatedly bound to covenants that must be fulfilled, heard, obeyed, and not unraveled. In that setting, guidance by permission becomes a communicative and relational circuit: an authorized summons is received and enacted, and route failure appears as covenant breach.

activation_trace.role: Listening and accepting what is heard opens permission toward reception.
Authorization keeps that reception under divine command.
Completion without deficiency makes covenant performance whole.
A binding obligation gives the route durable relational form.
A confirmed covenant supplies the setting for hearing and obedience.
Hearing as understanding and compliance turns reception into action.
Willing obedience completes the response side of guidance.
The explicit path from which one can stray ties covenant performance back to the focus route.
Unraveling what was made firm supplies the route's failure mechanism.

structural_cues: 5:1 opens with fulfilling binding obligations; 5:7 couples a covenant with hearing and obedience; 5:12 ends a list of covenant acts with straying from the path; 5:13 begins with breach.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated covenant mechanics, receptive obedience, explicit path loss, and breach; I infer that these are operating conditions of the focus guidance. A live alternative treats them as adjacent duties rather than as the mechanism of permission.

changed_reading.before: By His permission means that God allows the transfer.
changed_reading.after: Divine permission also functions as an authorized address that must be heard, accepted, performed, and kept intact over time.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hostility is treated as an input that must not be allowed to cross into aggression or crooked judgment. Cooperation in expansive good, sustained equitable witness, pardon, and graceful turning-away are active routing operations; forgetting a covenantal share instead feeds enmity and hatred.

activation_trace.role: Reconciliation opposite warfare anchors peace as conflict work.
Sustained care and upkeep make straightness an ongoing practice.
Hatred supplies the hostile pressure entering the routing mechanism.
Crossing a limit into wrongdoing names the prohibited output.
Mutual assistance supplies a collective routing operation whose object can be chosen.
Expansive good gives cooperation its peace-producing direction.
The upholding occurrence, grouped with the people occurrence, echoes the focus straightness root as maintained justice.
A straight balance supplies the measuring instrument of social straightness.
Justice in judgment and conduct is the demanded correction under hatred.
Leaving punishment and effacing offense interrupts retaliation.
Graceful turning-away supplies a second de-escalation operation.
Enmity is the relational state produced when the peace-routing mechanism fails.
Affective aversion shows the failure propagating into inner disposition.

structural_cues: 5:2 and 5:8 repeat the pattern hatred must not cause transgression or injustice; 5:13 supplies pardon and graceful turning-away; 5:14 contrasts forgotten covenantal material producing enmity and hatred.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hostile pressure, forbidden escalation, corrective practices, and a contrasting failure outcome; I infer a causal routing system in which peace is produced by disciplined responses. The alternative is to read these as separate virtues without making them the paths of peace.

changed_reading.before: The paths of peace lead away from already-ended conflict.
changed_reading.after: The paths of peace are repeatable controls that transform live hostility before it crosses into aggression, crooked judgment, or durable enmity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Darkness becomes a distributed textual disorder: wording is deflected from its placement, portions are neglected, and material is concealed. The arriving light and written message restore legibility by clarifying much, while overlooking much makes the disclosure selective rather than indiscriminate.

activation_trace.role: Bringing hidden material out anchors disclosure in the focus extraction.
Misplacement supplies a concrete form of textual darkness.
Conspicuous marking makes restored disclosure navigable.
Deflection from a direction supplies the displacement operation.
Placement in a due location supplies the order being disturbed.
Neglect and abandonment remove a portion from operative memory.
Concealment supplies the covered material to be disclosed.
Clarifying meaning by speech or sign supplies the disclosure operation.
Effacing an effect supplies deliberate non-exposure alongside clarification.
Ordered letters and the written object provide the medium whose legibility is restored.
The explicit contextual light confirms illumination as disclosure.

structural_cues: 5:13 sequences displaced wording and a forgotten portion; 5:15 answers with an envoy who clarifies much concealed material, overlooks much, and arrives with light and a clear written message.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies textual dislocation, concealment, clarification, selective overlooking, and explicit light; I infer that these form a repair process behind the focus transfer. A live alternative keeps darkness and light general while treating textual repair as only one instance.

changed_reading.before: The darknesses are generic ignorance and the light is total exposure.
changed_reading.after: The darknesses include accumulated dislocation, neglect, and concealment, while the light selectively restores enough legibility to make a route visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: A claim of filial and beloved status is tested against punishment, wrongdoing, creaturehood, and forgiveness. This sharpens the focus relative clause: access to guidance is characterized by enacted following of approval, not by inherited or asserted intimacy.

activation_trace.role: Active following supplies the focus criterion.
Acceptance supplies the relation that must be pursued rather than presumed.
Lineage and attributed origin supply the asserted inherited status.
Heart-attached love supplies the claimed privileged relation.
Punitive pain tests whether the claimed status exempts conduct from consequence.
Wrongdoing supplies the conduct for which identity does not substitute.
Created existence resets the claimants inside a shared creaturely category.
Protective covering of wrongdoing keeps mercy available without making it hereditary.

structural_cues: 5:18 places the claim of being children and beloved immediately against accountability for wrongdoing, common creaturehood, forgiveness, and punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a status claim and its conduct-based rebuttal; I infer that the focus's 'who follows' is deliberately open and performative. The alternative is that 5:18 rebuts only an excessive claim without defining eligibility in 5:16.

changed_reading.before: Guidance follows from belonging to a favored religious identity.
changed_reading.after: The guided class is constituted through following what God accepts; lineage and a claim to belovedness cannot replace that movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: A messenger arrives and clarifies after slackness in the relay, carrying both opening news and warning. The focus's spatial guidance can therefore also be read temporally as transmission restarting after an interval in which directional signals had weakened.

activation_trace.role: A leading vanguard gives guidance the form of an arriving advance signal.
A visible route marker supplies the restored signal.
Repeated arrival restarts contact.
Messenger and message define the relay being resumed.
Clarification turns renewed contact into usable direction.
Slackness after intensity supplies the temporal gap.
Joy-opening news supplies one polarity of the renewed signal.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the other polarity.

structural_cues: 5:19 repeats arrival around a stated interval between messengers and pairs renewed clarification with good news and warning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a slack interval, renewed arrival, clarification, and a two-pole message; I infer a temporal signal-restoration model for guidance. A live alternative preserves the focus as purely spatial and treats the interval only as historical timing.

changed_reading.before: Guidance points along a continuously available spatial route.
changed_reading.after: Guidance can also be the restoration of directional transmission after a period of weakened relay.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence opposes commanded entry to backward reversal, waiting for opponents to exit, refusal to enter, permanent sitting, and eventual wandering. It turns guidance into threshold action: divine extraction does not mean waiting passively for every external obstruction to remove itself.

activation_trace.role: Road-leading anchors the closing movement sequence in the focus.
Exit from an enclosing state supplies the focus's liberation movement.
Entry into an interior makes guidance a threshold-crossing command.
Returning backward supplies the prohibited reversal.
Turning one's back gives reversal bodily orientation.
Turning a thing away from its face supplies the resulting inversion.
Repeated entry language makes crossing the disputed action.
The demand that opponents first exit externalizes the condition the refusers impose on action.
The answering counsel repeats entry as the decisive movement.
A concrete entrance localizes the decisive threshold.
Reliance joins rather than replaces threshold action.
Permanent refusal negates the required movement.
Duration and stillness harden a temporary obstacle into an indefinite excuse.
Sitting out the action supplies the opposite of following.

structural_cues: 5:21 commands entry and prohibits backward turning; 5:22 conditions entry on others' prior exit; 5:23 redirects action through the gate with reliance; 5:24 fixes refusal as permanent sitting; branchless ت ي ه at 5:26 marks the resulting wandering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated entry/exit reversal, a gate, reliance joined to action, immobilized refusal, and later wandering; I infer that the focus extraction requires responsive threshold crossing rather than passive obstacle removal. The alternative is that the closing narrative illustrates disobedience generally without specifying the mechanics of guidance.

changed_reading.before: Being brought from darkness to light is a passive relocation performed on recipients.
changed_reading.after: Divine extraction opens a threshold that followers must enter; demanding that the obstacle leave first converts a straight route into reversal, stasis, and wandering.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers the sacrificial noun's material image onto verbal guidance. It remains anchored by the exact guidance root at 5:16 and 5:2, the collared sanctuary-bound offering, deliberate aiming, and sought approval. Downstream prose should call it a ritual analogy, not claim that the focus verbs grammatically mean sacrificial offering.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The two guidance verbs can carry an exploratory echo of something gently delivered toward sacred custody.

activation_trace.role: The offering-to-sanctuary branch supplies the exploratory transfer image inside the focus root.

A visible neck marker identifies consecrated custody during transport.
Deliberate aiming keeps the analogy directional.
Refuge supplies the receiving destination.
Sought approval connects consecrated movement to the focus criterion.

changed_reading.before: God instructs and escorts a follower.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the follower is also imaged as something gently delivered into sacred refuge, so guidance resembles consecrated transfer.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the swallowing branch of the path root through the packet's dense intake rules. It remains anchored in the focus path word and the 5:1-5 sequence of released prohibitions, forbidden intake, eating, holding, and shared food. Downstream prose should present it as a material analogy for disciplined permeability, not as the ordinary lexical sense of the straight path.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The straight path's branch inventory includes passage by swallowing.

activation_trace.role: Disappearance through passage and swallowing supplies the regulated-intake image.
Release of a prohibition opens selected material to passage.
Prohibition closes other material against intake.
Taking food in makes bodily passage explicit.
Holding material back supplies a gate before intake.
Tasting and taking food extends regulated passage across communities.

changed_reading.before: The straight path is an external route traveled by a person.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is disciplined permeability: a rule-governed passage determining what may be taken in, what must be held back, and how incorporation remains safe.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the form-distant non-dominant ه د د target attached to the focus guidance root. It remains anchored by the repeated guidance forms, the focus extraction from obstructive darkness, and the later gate/stasis contrast. Downstream prose must label it a split-root resonance rather than translating guidance as demolition.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The non-dominant mapped inventory lets repeated guidance resonate with breaking an enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Severe breaking and demolition provide the deliberately form-distant resonance.
Exit from an enclosing state attaches the resonance to an actual focus movement.
Confinement and withholding make the darkness an obstruction capable of being broken.
A gate materializes the enclosing threshold.
Sitting out action shows the immobilization the breaking image would oppose.

changed_reading.before: Guidance gently indicates an available road.
changed_reading.after: At the split-root edge, guidance also resonates as breaking the enclosure that keeps a person blocked from exit and entry.

strongest_changes: Plural paths became circumstance-sensitive procedures and conflict-regulating practices that converge on one maintained alignment.
Darkness-to-light became selective repair of displaced, forgotten, and concealed material rather than generic illumination.
Permission became covenantal reception through hearing, obedience, performance, and non-breach.
The closing entry/refusal sequence turned guidance into threshold action opposed to reversal, stasis, and wandering.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly materialized the focus's abstract movement as ritual convoy, bodily purification, covenant maintenance, equitable conflict handling, textual disclosure, restored message relay, and gate crossing without forcing those mechanisms into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: How strongly the sanctuary-offering sense should color the verbal guidance forms rather than remain a contextual analogy.
Whether the hearing branch of permission is a durable semantic layer or only activated by the nearby hearing-obedience covenant.
Whether selective overlooking is part of the light's mechanism or simply accompanies disclosure.
Whether the swallowing and demolition outliers remain useful after their branch distance is made explicit.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Many safe routes converge into one straight passage.** `س ب ل B001` supplies extended traversed ways, `س ل م B001` soundness/safety, and `ص ر ط B001` the straight road. The plural-to-singular sequence is the structural cue. I infer that differing routes of repair can converge upon a shared orientation without being erased at entry.
2. **Guidance combines gentle leading and composure.** `ه د ي B001` is gentle guidance and `ه د ي B010` calm stillness. Between plural darknesses and light, I infer that guidance both moves and stabilizes: it leads out, then gives a composed bearing on the road.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayah 5:120 made the fixed ayah's local distinctions newly visible as bounded operations within a single encompassing dominion, rather than as an isolated rule or episode.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Guidance is a maintained change of orientation.** Fixed **ق و م / B008** (“straightness, uprightness, and evenness”) is carried by *mustaqīm*, after the ayah’s exit from plural darknesses and movement among peace-paths. In 5:21 the commanded travelers must enter the land and not turn back on their rear parts. I infer that light enables a corrected bearing that must then be held against reversal. The straight path reads as sustained orientation after extraction, not a static line merely pointed out.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 5:21’s command not to turn back made “straight” unexpectedly dynamic: guidance must be maintained against bodily reversal.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, yanılgının karşıtı olan doğru yönelişi, yolu veya doğruyu incelikle gösterip tanıtmayı, gösterileni benimsemeyi ve ilahi başarı desteğini birlikte kapsar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, sıradan bir armağanı ya da yalnızca yolun kendisini değil, doğru yönü bildirme ve ona yönelme ilişkisini anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dal anlamı tanımlanır; başka dallardaki armağan, adanmış sunu ve özel kullanım anlamları buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimseye yolu, doğruyu ya da benimsenmesi gereken yönü incelikle göstermek ve tanıtmak; gösterilen yönü kabul ederek doğruya ulaşmak, ayrıca bunun ilahi başarı desteğiyle gerçekleşmesidir.

facets.statement: Doğru yönü, yolu veya gerçeği incelikle göstermek, açıklamak ve tanıtmaktır.
Gösterilen doğru yönü isteyerek kabul etme ve ona ulaşma sürecini de kapsar.
Dinsel doğruya yöneltme ve bu yönelişi mümkün kılan ilahi başarı desteği özel bir gerçekleşmedir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar doğru yönü gösterme, yolu tanıtma ve yanılgının karşıtı olan doğruya erişme çekirdeğinde birleşir; anlatım, insanın gösterileni seçip benimsemesini ve ilahi başarı desteğini de içerir. Bir kaynakta itaat ve sakınma da bu anlam alanındaki gerçekleşmeler arasında sayılır.

concept_gloss.text: doğru yolu gösterme ve doğruya yönelme
concept_gloss.applicability: Yolun veya gerçeğin bildirilmesiyle başlayıp gösterilen doğru yönün benimsenmesine uzanan bütün çekirdek için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Gösterme, tanıtma, benimseme ve doğruya ulaşma basamaklarını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişiye somut ya da düşünsel bir yolun tanıtıldığı geçişlerde doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yolu bildirme ve kişiyi doğru yöne sevk etme yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Gösterileni benimseme ve ilahi başarı desteği yönlerini tek başına anlatmaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gösterilen yönü kabul edip doğruya ulaşan kişinin durumunu anlatan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Doğru yönü benimseyerek ona ulaşma sonucunu açıkça korur.
error_profile.loses: Başkasının yolu gösterme eylemini ve ilahi başarı desteğini belirtmez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: doğru yol, doğruyu gösterme ve açıklama

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal doğruluk ve doğru yol niteliğini, ayrıca yanlıştan uzak duran olgun kararı öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yanılgıdan uzaklaşıp doğru yola veya doğru karara ulaşma alanını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın çekirdeği bir yönü gösterme ve gösterilen yönü benimseme ilişkisidir; komşu dal ise doğru olma ve doğru yolda bulunma niteliğini daha geniş biçimde taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Doğru yönü bildirme, benimseme ve ona ulaşma vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Doğru amaçtan sapma, yanlışa düşme ve yolunu yitirme vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı doğru yön ile ondan uzaklaşma ekseninin karşıt uçlarında yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yönün bulunmasını ve benimsenmesini bildirirken komşu dal o yönden ayrılmayı ve yolunu yitirmeyi bildirir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الهدى والهداية بمعنى الرشاد والدلالة والبيان وتعريف الطريق أو الحق والدين والاهتداء والتوفيق الإلهي وقبول الهدى
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الهدية بمعنى العطاء ولا الهدي المهدى إلى الحرم ولا مجرد أول الشيء إلا إذا كان للتقدم والإرشاد
branches.source_phrase_ar: الهدى نقيض الضلالة؛ هدي فاهتدى (ayn;tahdhib)؛ الهدى الرشاد والدلالة؛ هداه الله للدين هدى؛ أولم يبين لهم؛ هديته الطريق والبيت هداية أي عرفته (sihah)؛ الهدى البيان وإخراج شيء إلى شيء والطاعة والورع؛ دله على الطريق (tahdhib)؛ الهداية دلالة بلطف؛ تعريف الطرق؛ التوفيق (mufradat)؛ التقدم للإرشاد؛ هديته الطريق هداية؛ الهدى خلاف الضلالة (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü bir işin yönünü ve amacını, kişinin gidişini, görünür tutumunu ve yöntemini, ayrıca sürmekte olan söz veya işi bırakmamayı birlikte verir. Verilen çerçeve bu çok parçalı fakat bağlantılı kullanımı korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca genel bir yaşam tarzı değildir; yön ve amaç bildiren kullanımlarla belirli bir işte veya söylemde kalma kullanımını da içerir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yön, gidiş ve tutum bildiren biçimler ile kalıplaşmış benzerlik ve yineleme kullanımları ayrı yüzler olarak tutulur; özel kullanımlar çıplak kökün tümüne yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir işin yönü, amacı ve izlenen doğrultusu ile bir kimsenin gidişi, görünür tutumu ve yöntemidir. Belirli anlatımlarda yürütülen söz ya da işten sapmama, başkasının yolunu izleme, ona benzeme veya aynı karşılığı yineleme anlamı kazanır.

facets.statement: Bir işin yönünü, hedefini ve izlenen doğrultusunu bildirir.
Bir kimsenin gidişini, görünür tutumunu ve izlediği yöntemi anlatır.
Sürmekte olan söz veya işi bırakmama ve başkasının izlediği yolu izleme kullanımını içerir.
Özel bir söyleyişte benzerini verme veya aynı işi yeniden yapma anlamı taşır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak anlatımı yön ve amaç ile kişinin izlediği yol ve görünür tutumu aynı kavramsal alanda toplar; sürmekte olan işten sapmama, başkasının yolunu izleme ve özel bir söyleyişte benzerini ya da tekrarını yapma kullanımları buna bağlıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir işin doğrultusunu ve bir kişinin davranış biçimini birlikte karşılayan genel kavram haritasında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yön, amaç, yöntem, görünür tutum ve izlenen gidiş çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir işin hangi doğrultuya baktığı veya hangi amaçla yürütüldüğü sorulduğunda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: İşin yönünü, hedefini ve izlenen doğrultusunu açıkça korur.
error_profile.loses: Kişinin tutumunu, yöntemini ve özel benzerlik ya da yineleme kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kimsenin davranış biçiminin veya yönteminin örnek alınıp sürdürüldüğü bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Başkasının gidişini ve yöntemini izleme yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir işin soyut yönünü ve benzerini verme ya da yineleme kullanımını belirtmez.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه هدي الأمر أو هديته بمعنى جهته ووجهته وقصده وسيرته وطريقته وسمته وما يلازم ذلك من لزوم الحديث أو العمل والمماثلة في هدياها
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الهدى بمعنى الإرشاد الديني وحده ولا الهدية العطية ولا مشي التمايل المعتمد على اثنين
branches.source_phrase_ar: خذ في هديتك أي فيما كنت فيه من الحديث أو العمل ولا تعدل عنه؛ هدية أمره وسيرته؛ هدى هدي فلان أي سار سيرته (sihah)؛ هدية أمره أي جهة أمره؛ هديت به أي قصدت به؛ هديه أي سمته؛ ليس لهذا الأمر هدية ولا قبلة ولا دبرة ولا وجهة؛ هدياها أي مثلها أو أعاودك (tahdhib)؛ هدية فلان وهديه أي طريقته (mufradat)؛ نظر فلان هدي أمره أي جهته؛ ما أحسن هديته أي هديه؛ رميت بآخر هدياه أي قصده (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü temel olarak bir şeyin ilk veya önde bulunan bölümünü bildirir; yol gösterme, bazı öndekilerin başkalarına öncülük etmesinden doğan bağlı bir açıklamadır. Bu nedenle dal korunabilir, ancak her öndeki parçanın yol gösterdiği düşünülmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek öncülük etmek değil, önde veya ilk sırada bulunmaktır; yol gösterme yalnızca uygun örneklerde buna bağlanır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel olarak ilk veya öndeki şey anlamı ile atların, yaban hayvanlarının, okun ve koyunun belirli ön parçalarını adlandıran kullanımlar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin ilk, önde bulunan veya öne çıkan bölümü ya da üyesidir. Atların boyunları veya ilk sırası, yaban hayvanlarının öncüleri, okun ucu, koyunun boynu ve sahibinin önünde ilerleyen değnek bu konumsal çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir bütünün ilk veya önde bulunan bölümü ya da üyesidir.
Atların boyunlarını veya ilk sırasını ve yaban hayvanlarının önde gidenlerini adlandırır.
Okun ucunu ve koyunun boynunu, öndeki parçalar olmaları bakımından adlandırır.
Önden ilerleyen değnek veya kılavuz, önde bulunma yoluyla başkasına yön gösterir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bir şeyin ilk ve öndeki bölümünde birleşir; atların boynu ya da ilk sırası, yaban hayvanlarının öncüleri, koyun boynu, ok ucu ve önde ilerleyen değnek bu konumsal çekirdeği farklı nesnelerde gerçekleştirir. Önden giden kılavuz da aynı konumsal ilişkiyle adlandırılır.

concept_gloss.text: bir şeyin ilk veya öndeki bölümü
concept_gloss.applicability: Genel konumsal çekirdeği ve hayvan, araç ya da nesnelerdeki özel ön bölüm adlarını birlikte temsil eder.
